b3a86b51a6.q: How do candidates and clients behave differently when opening recruitment emails?
b3a86b51a6.a: Candidates open emails more frequently out of curiosity but often do nothing else. Clients and hiring managers open less often but click through at more than three times the rate of candidates, around 13% for clients against under 4% for candidates. This shows that a hiring manager who opens and clicks is a highly qualified, intentional reader.

e9a3d11027.q: What are the three main jobs that email marketing performs better than any other channel in recruitment?
e9a3d11027.a: Email does three jobs better than anything else: reigniting people you've gone quiet with or silent with from your past client and candidate database; nurturing prospects through the buying cycle by staying in front of people who aren't ready yet but eventually will be; and building authority and thought leadership through regular newsletters, market updates, and salary insights to stop being a supplier and start being an advisor.
